summary: Backend + Frontend E2E for Obserra EIOS. Backend crosswalk + recheck + compliance regression: 9/9 pytest pass. Compliance UI (/app/compliance): Posture + Crosswalk tabs work; 6 summary cards render (data-testid crosswalk-summary-NIST-800-53 / CIS-v8 / SOC-2 / SSDF / PCI-DSS / ISO-27001 — uppercase, punctuation replaced with '-'); crosswalk-table has 6 rows with per-control verdicts (Compliant/Non-compliant) and 'n/a' shown for empty PCI/SSDF cells. Available Connectors (/app/connectors): openai auto-connects LIVE with 'Awaiting first live sync' badge; openai-recheck keeps LIVE; catalog connect-aws → 'LIVE · synced just now' (data-testid catalog-aws-synced), sync-aws updates, disconnect-aws reverts to Connect. No 'MOCKED'/'records ingested' fabricated text. CRITICAL BUG: AI Governance page (/app/ai-governance) throws 'ReferenceError: live is not defined' — entire page crashes, ai-licenses-card never renders. Root cause: AIGovernance.jsx references `live?.copilot`, `live?.openai`, `live?.m365` and `{live && ...}` (lines 45-48, 67) but the `live` state is never declared or fetched. Missing useState + api.get('/enterprise/live') call.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'This connector cannot be re-checked'. Teams is a webhook connector and AvailableConnectors.jsx correctly does NOT render a teams-recheck button — but review spec implied all 5 live connectors expose recheck. Not a blocker; behavior is intentionally omitted in UI.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: live is not defined — page crashes on load. `live` variable is used at lines 45-48 (const copilot=live?.copilot; openai=live?.openai; m365=live?.m365; anyLicensed=...) and line 67 ({live && <ai-licenses-card>...}) but is never declared via useState nor populated via api.get('/enterprise/live'). Must add: `const [live,setLive]=useState(null);` and in load() also `api.get('/enterprise/live').then(r=>setLive(r.data));`.

integration_issues.issue: Because AIGovernance page crashes, the entire AI licenses card (lic-copilot / lic-openai / lic-m365) never renders regardless of whether connectors are LIVE.

action_items: FIX AIGovernance.jsx: add `const [live, setLive] = useState(null);` and call `api.get('/enterprise/live').then(r => setLive(r.data));` inside load(). This will restore the entire AI Governance page + AI Licenses & Copilot Governance card.
(Optional/spec-alignment) If teams-recheck is expected per spec, add a recheck branch for 'teams' in /app/backend/live_connectors.py:recheck_live (currently only m365/copilot/openai/sso are handled).
critical_code_review_comments: AIGovernance.jsx uses `live` state without declaring it — clear regression from a refactor. Blocks the whole AI Governance route with a React uncaught runtime error overlay.

Backend GET /api/controls/crosswalk cleanly returns {frameworks, framework_full, rows, summary, compliant_controls, total_controls}. Summary correctly excludes rows with empty mapping from per-framework totals (SSDF excludes BCP-2, PCI DSS excludes AIG-1). row.compliant matches (status=='Passing').
Backend GET /api/controls/compliance now aggregates across the 6 crosswalk frameworks — verified all 6 names present, no legacy CSF-only shape.

CompliancePosture.jsx testid convention: `crosswalk-summary-<framework>` uses `framework.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,'-')`, producing UPPERCASE ids (e.g. 'crosswalk-summary-NIST-800-53', 'crosswalk-summary-CIS-v8'). Task spec examples read lowercase — clarify convention or normalize toLowerCase() for consistency.

AvailableConnectors auto-connect + recheck-stays-live works for all 4 UI-recheckable kinds (m365/copilot/openai/sso). Catalog one-click live (aws) works end-to-end; no fabricated record counts observed.

rca of the issue: AIGovernance.jsx references `live` variable (lines 45-48, 67) but never declares state nor fetches /api/enterprise/live. React throws ReferenceError on component render. Reproduction: login as admin → navigate to /app/ai-governance → red 'Uncaught runtime errors: live is not defined' overlay appears. Fix: import/copy the pattern used in AvailableConnectors.jsx — add `const [live,setLive] = useState(null);` and inside load() add `api.get('/enterprise/live').then(r=>setLive(r.data));`.
